tezera organiser flow

Desktop web portal screens for the organiser account, covering every branch of the organiser mind map (ticketing, which comes after the ATP, is left out). Use the flow map to see each journey end to end, or click through the screens: highlighted areas are real links.

About these screens
  • Palette is the Organiser palette from brand manual v1.1: slate #526C80 primary, sage #70A98D secondary, #6F908B accent on #D7DFEA. Dark is a reworked organiser dark set: slate #9DBBD0 primary on #10161D, a #283849 side menu, sage #1E302A panels with lighter sage #365248 rows inside, and #26323E cards.
  • Small tags on screens (Should, Could, Proposed, To decide) carry the priority notes from the mind map.
  • Yellow hotspots show a message instead of changing screen (for example Apply or Mark received). Download SVG saves the current screen so it can be dropped into Figma.
